properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.max-output-tokens
properties.description: Upper bound on the tokens the model may generate, including reasoning tokens.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.reasoning-effort
properties.description: How hard the model should think: none, minimal, low, medium or high. Anything other than 'none' together with tool calling is the case Chat Completions no longer serves on recent models.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.reasoning-summary
properties.description: Whether to summarize the model's reasoning: auto, concise or detailed. Summaries appear under the 'reasoningContent' metadata key. Raw reasoning text is never returned by OpenAI.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.verbosity
properties.description: How verbose the answer should be: low, medium or high.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.strict
properties.description: Whether tool schemas are sent as strict. Left unset, Spring AI sends strict=false explicitly, matching OpenAiChatModel; the Responses API would otherwise attempt strict mode, which Spring AI's generated schemas frequently do not satisfy.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.include
properties.description: Extra fields to include in the response, for example web_search_call.results. reasoning.encrypted_content is always requested, because replaying a reasoning turn is impossible without it.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.truncation
properties.description: 'auto' lets OpenAI drop items when the context window overflows; 'disabled' fails instead.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.max-tool-calls
properties.description: Upper bound on the number of tool calls in a single response.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.safety-identifier
properties.description: A stable, non-identifying id for the end user, used by OpenAI's abuse detection.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.hosted-tools.web-search.enabled
properties.description: Let OpenAI search the web inside the request. Its calls are reported under the 'openai.responses.hosted_tool_calls' key on the generation metadata and are never surfaced as tool calls for the application to run.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.hosted-tools.file-search.vector-store-ids
properties.description: Vector stores hosted at OpenAI to search. Setting at least one enables the file search tool.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.hosted-tools.code-interpreter.enabled
properties.description: Let OpenAI run Python in a sandboxed container inside the request.

properties.name: spring.ai.openai.responses.hosted-tools.image-generation.enabled
properties.description: Let OpenAI generate images inside the request. Generated images arrive as media on the assistant message.
